text:
Marta: FYI opened a docs PR to expand the Dedicated Capacity provisioning page with autoscaling policy examples + a migration checklist — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3125 :point_up:
Raj: Nice. Is this meant to replace the old autoscaling doc or sit alongside it as an ops how-to?
Marta: Sit alongside. The goal is a concise ops playbook (provision -> configure autoscale -> migrate traffic) + SDK snippets (py/js) and a small SLA note.
Sam: Can you paste the Python snippet here so I can validate CLI/flag parity?
Marta: Sure — quick example:```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
policy = {"min_replicas": 2, "max_replicas": 20, "scale_target_rps": 500}
client.update_autoscale_policy(pool_id="pool-123", policy=policy)
```
Natalie: Legal asked we standardize SLA phrasing. They want the page to say exactly: "Redwood Dedicated: 99.95% availability for Reserved pools under the Dedicated SLA." Left a comment on the PR.
Kevin: Also call out network isolation & KMS behavior differences between Dedicated and Private (customers keep keys in Private). I wrote a short blurb in the PR.
Marta: Adding a small comparison table and a migration checklist to the PR draft: - snapshot model + configs - export deployment manifest - create dedicated pool with same model + resources - warmup KV cache - shift traffic over 4-6h (canary)
Raj: Heads-up: provisioning step links to old CLI flag `--cluster`. Should be `redwood dedicated create-pool --name`. I pushed a suggested change.
Marta: Thanks — fixed that link and updated the CLI examples. @raj @sam @kevin @natalie can you review? Aiming to merge by EOD tomorrow.
docs-bot: PR #3125 requested reviews:Raj, Sam, Kevin. Status: changes requested (1 comment).
Sam: Tested the Python snippet against staging. It works, but we should mention that `scale_target_rps` is computed as a 5m moving average and can be tuned with `scale_window_seconds`.
Marta: Added the note about averaging + sample values for small/medium/large pools. Also included an autoscaling YAML example for Console configuration.
Kevin: Add a note about KV cache invalidation during model swaps — observed transient 503s if not warmed; recommend pre-warm or a short fallback policy.
Marta: Good catch — added warmup step and linked to the runtime cache docs (eng-runtime).
Natalie: LGTM except one tiny grammar nit in the migration checklist.
Raj: Approved. :shipit:
Marta: Fixed the nit, rebased, and pushed. I'll merge after CI.
Marta: Merged — preview URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/provisioning#autoscaling (preview). :tada:
Kevin: Can someone add a small JS SDK snippet later? I can proof the wording for the KMS section.
Marta: Will add basic JS tomorrow and ping you for KMS phrasing. Thanks everyone!
